name: Open stay: a plan past day 90 does not fit

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)

Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry date 2026-10-01 (data-testid=trip-entry), tick 'I'm still in the Schengen area' (data-testid=trip-open) and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
The status panel latest legal exit (data-testid=latest-exit) shows 2026-12-29
In the planned trip form (data-testid=planned-form) enter planned entry 2026-12-01 and planned exit 2027-01-15, then click check (data-testid=planned-check)
The planned trip result (data-testid=planned-result) says 'Does not fit'
The planned trip result names 2026-12-29 as the latest legal exit, the same date as the status panel (data-testid=latest-exit)
